theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Materials (+1.12%) and Health Care (+0.74%) led the market today, while Energy (-1.85%) and Utilities (-1.38%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.32%, defensives -0.30%, and value/cyclicals -0.18% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained +0.83% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -0.40%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.27%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 3.21% to 15.97, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 2.72% to $4,300.40, crude oil was little changed at $74.97, and bitcoin gained 0.80% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
